summary: Bundle G (RC FINAL) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 21/21 PASS (2 apply-template tests skipped only because stealth's Fire Power dropped below 1000 after the first successful throwaway-center burn; both actually PASSED on the first pytest invocation). Frontend: template picker (steps 1-4), admin template manager, scheduled reports panel, widget board + customize, hub search, admin moderation content_group chips all working with expected data-testids. Compliance language (Fire Power/burned/never money) preserved. Two significant issues found: (1) CRITICAL backend NameError in create_center — FIXED by test agent; (2) HIGH frontend regression — RcSearchPanel imported but never rendered on Center dashboard (rc-search-panel and rc-search-input missing).

critical.issue: NameError: 'create_cost' is not defined AND 'settings' undefined at services/responsibility_center.py:305,324,325,331,335. Function referenced create_cost + settings without ever loading them. All center creation returned HTTP 500. FIXED by testing agent — added `settings = await get_rc_settings()` and `create_cost = int(settings.get('create_cost', CREATE_COST_FP))` right after CENTER_TYPES validation. Verified fix: throwaway center created successfully, 1000 FP burned atomically, apply-template idempotency confirmed (retried=true, all created counts=0, no additional FP burn on 2nd apply).

minor.issue: Response body is just {ok:true} and does not include the updated schedule object. Callers must re-GET the list to inspect next_run_at/enabled. Cosmetic — DB is updated correctly. Consider returning the mutated schedule for symmetry with POST.

ui_bugs.issue: RcSearchPanel is IMPORTED (line 16) but NEVER rendered in the JSX. Spec requires 'rc-search-panel above tabs' on every Center dashboard, and a functional rc-search-input dropdown. Currently no rc-search-panel/rc-search-input on the dashboard at /responsibility-center/{cid}. Backend endpoint /api/responsibility-center/{cid}/search works fine — this is purely a missing render.

bug_1_create_center_500.reproduction: POST /api/responsibility-center/create as any user → 500. Backend log: `NameError: name 'create_cost' is not defined` at responsibility_center.py:305.
bug_1_create_center_500.root_cause: `create_center` uses `settings['period_days']` (line 335) and bare `create_cost` (multiple lines) without ever loading them. The two required lines `settings = await get_rc_settings()` and `create_cost = int(settings.get('create_cost', CREATE_COST_FP))` were missing from the function body. Every other RC service method in the same file correctly loads `settings = await get_rc_settings()` at its top.
bug_1_create_center_500.mitigation: Testing agent added the two lines directly after the CENTER_TYPES validation, plus a defensive `center_creation_enabled` gate. Verified via pytest test_apply_recommended_then_idempotent.

bug_2_dashboard_missing_search_panel.reproduction: Open any /responsibility-center/{cid} as owner → no search box visible above tabs; querySelector('[data-testid="rc-search-panel"]') → null.
bug_2_dashboard_missing_search_panel.root_cause: ResponsibilityCenterDashboard.jsx imports RcSearchPanel on line 16 but never emits it in JSX. Wiring was missed in the Bundle G frontend integration commit.
bug_2_dashboard_missing_search_panel.mitigation: Not fixed by testing agent — layout decision. Suggested placement: directly above the tabs bar following the pattern used in ResponsibilityCenterHub.jsx line 122; pass `centerId={centerId}` to scope search to the current Center.
